newsitem.title: USA: Dentsply sees flat Q2 EPS of $0.66.
newsitem.headline: Dentsply sees flat Q2 EPS of $0.66.

text.p: DENTSPLY International Inc on Thursday said it expected to post second-quarter earnings of about $0.66 a share, equal to the year earlier quarter.

The company, which makes X-ray equipment, said its earnings would show no earnings growth in the quarter because of the cost of relocating its Preventive Care division's manufacturing facilities to a new plant in York, Pennsylvania.
It also cited the recent acquisition of New Image Industries and the negative impact of the strong U.S. dollar on sales in European currencies.

"Although we expect flat second-quarter earnings, we remain optimistic about the remainder of the year. Production at the new Preventive Care facility in York has started, and shipments should be strong as we reduce backlog to normal levels by the end of the third quarter," the company said in a statement.
The company said it expected New Image to cut its losses in the third quarter and to become operationally profitable by the end of the year.
"We believe we are well positioned to achieve record earnings in 1997 and continued growth in the long term," the company said.
The company expects sales of about $178 million for the second quarter ending June 30, an increase of eight percent from the 1996 quarter.
Shares of Dentsply rose 1-7/8 to close at 52-1/8 on Thursday.
